facts: Parties: Larkspur Logistics plc (Buyer), Ivybridge Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Netherby Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 16 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 November 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $5,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,650,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $79,300,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $1,200,000.
